title: Qualify Mirror Symmetry to Fixed-Loft Shot Delivery
body:
## Problem

The general symmetry statement ignored that the same right-handed shaft axis maps opposite face errors to different delivered lofts. Coupled draw/fade differences can be structural, not merely sampling.

## Acceptance Criteria

Qualify mirror symmetry to fixed loft; explain that a full physical reflection would also mirror the shaft geometry. Retain sampling-only CI limits and avoid player-specific preference claims.

## Validation

Astra independently checked geometric parity and the six corrected SD1 scale1 bundles; PW fixed draw/fade lateral SDs are almost identical while same-axis coupled SDs differ. No scientific equations were changed.

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
